Edit this existing Pop Rush board sprite by making the sixteen bubble wells as large as the square game board can accommodate. Keep the existing glossy cyan-blue rounded case and turquoise playfield, but slim down the bulky blue bezel on all four sides so the playable grid occupies 86–88% of the full square canvas in both dimensions. The sixteen identical round concave pale-lavender wells must be precisely four columns by four rows in a regular front-on square grid. Aim for centers around 17%, 39%, 61%, and 83% of canvas on both x and y, with diameter about 21% of canvas and a very narrow but visible gap between neighboring wells. All wells, including the corner wells, must remain complete circles, with just enough clearance for the rounded case. Center the square grid on both axes. The slim outer case retains glossy highlights and soft violet rim lighting. Tiny gold glints, if retained, must be outside the playfield. Match the current polished 3D toy-game style and square composition. Keep true transparent RGBA outside the full, unclipped board silhouette. Output only the board. No rabbit or ears, no hands, no text, no buttons, no badges, no new props, no perspective tilt. The key visible change is that the bubble wells are clearly bigger and the blue frame thinner than the input.

Generate a single production sprite atlas (one transparent PNG), a one-row strip of exactly four standalone matching green silicone pop-it disc frames for the Pop Rush mobile game. Treat the provided 12-frame sheet as a visual reference for the GREEN CIRCULAR MEMBRANE ONLY. Reference frame positions are counted left to right and top to bottom. From left to right make: 1) like reference frame 1, relaxed raised matte dome; 2) like frame 4, the same dome with the first compact soft central dimple, still largely convex; 3) like frame 6, the same disc with a wide and deep compressed dimple spreading up and out, stronger soft dark green central shadow, some convex perimeter still present; 4) like frame 7 or 12, fully inverted bowl with a darker green upper inner surface and softly illuminated lower interior, a slim softly curved green lip. The four states must have precisely identical front-facing orthographic circular silhouettes, diameter, horizontal spacing and vertical alignment, as frames of one animation. Soft light from top-left, rich leaf-green as in the reference, mint-green diffuse highlight on upper left, emerald shading on lower side, never near-white or neon. The fully inverted frame is flat to the viewer and looks like reference frame 12, without any green glow or flash. No drawn edge line, external drop shadow, blue casing, grid cells, board, hands, objects, text, letters, decoration, check marks or lighting effects. Output on actual transparent alpha outside the four discs. A wide regularly spaced landscape strip with all circles intact and equal, centered at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, and 87.5% of width, 50% height. Keep a visible clear transparent separation between the discs. Make the change of central concavity between all four frames clear at 40 pixels.
